description: One row per number we own. A DID is what tells an inbound call which grain it belongs to. A call arriving on an UNMAPPED number is dropped -- that is what keeps a shared provider account's other businesses out of this CRM.

fields.description: As the provider sends it. It arrives both ways -- '9240276210' on IVR calls and '+919240276210' on Dialer calls -- so the row is keyed on the last 10 digits, not on this string.
fields.label: DID Number

fields.description: What this number is, in plain English. Shown in lists.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Unticked, this number is treated as unmapped -- its calls are logged raw and dropped.
fields.label: Enabled
